summary: Successfully implemented extended I/O metrics collection for Apache Kafka (KAFKA-20223). Added 5 new metrics (rchar, wchar, syscr, syscw, cancelled_write_bytes) to the existing 2 metrics (read-bytes, write-bytes). Updated LinuxIoMetricsCollector.java to collect these metrics from /proc/self/io, and registered them as JMX gauges in both KafkaBroker.scala and ControllerServer.scala. All 16 tests pass: 3 unit tests for LinuxIoMetricsCollector and 13 integration tests for MetricsTest including testLinuxIoMetrics() which validates all 7 metrics are properly registered.
